channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bol Bol | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bol Bol from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Bol Bol, South Sudan
item.description:
Durant has been so moved by representing Team USA that he has encouraged other players to take advantage of the Olympic experience whenever it presents itself.

“Bol Bol had the chance to play for South Sudan, and I was encouraging him to do so,”

Kevin Durant on Bol Bol, South Sudan, Sep 11, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Tyus Jones on Bol Bol
item.description:
PHNX Suns:Tyus Jones on Bol Bol:

“Honestly, he's just playing lights out, shooting with confidence,making plays, being active on defense, blocking shots, protecting the rim.... So he's been huge for us, and we're gonna continue to need that moving forward”

Tyus Jones on Bol Bol, Mar 1, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Ralph Sampson on Manute Bol, Bol Bol
item.description:
Ralph Sampson:

“Bol Bol is an elite talent. I played with Bol Bol’s father, Manute, and he didn’t have the same talent that his son has. He can change the game if he wants to,but he’s gotta want to get it done, and you gotta have that grit. He can’t just settle for the 3, and Wembanyama can’t just settle for the 3 when the game’s on the line. You gotta find your niche and you gotta make it to the basket, you gotta score.”

Ralph Sampson on Manute Bol, Bol Bol, Sep 14, 2024. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Josh Bartelstein on Bol Bol, Grayson Allen, Damion Lee
item.description:
“Players on our team from Bol Bol, Grayson Allen and Damion Lee, you’re seeing more and more players start their careers in the G League and grow, learn our system, learn how we want to play it, and one day contribute at the high-up stage of playing in NBA games,NBA playoff games and hopefully winning an NBA championship.”

Josh Bartelstein on Bol Bol, Grayson Allen, Damion Lee, May 23, 2024. Source: gophnx.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Bol Bol
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Kevin Durant on Bol Bol:

“People on the outside, it's hard for them to see, but he's been more than I expected. His intangibles, his work ethic, his IQ -- all the stuff that I didn't really think about when it comes to Bol, that's the foundation of his game.”

Kevin Durant on Bol Bol, Feb 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Bol Bol
item.description:
Frank Vogel on Bol Bol starting to carve out rotation minutes for himself:

“We're at that phase where we're seeing how he consistently fits in this puzzle.”

Frank Vogel on Bol Bol, Feb 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Bol Bol
item.description:
“I love what he brings. I love everything about Bol. You can tell everybody loves Bol. Rooting for him.”

Kevin Durant on Bol Bol, Feb 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Bol Bol
item.description:
Frank Vogel on Bol Bol's foot sprain:

“We're still doing more evaluation on that, and we should have more info tomorrow or Thursday on that.”

Frank Vogel on Bol Bol, Jan 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Bol Bol
item.description:
“Bol had picked up some momentum with three positive games. We’re excited to get him back in there.”

Frank Vogel on Bol Bol, Jan 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Michael Porter Jr on Bol Bol
item.description:
Michael Porter Jr. on Bol Bol:

“We all knew that he was a very talented player. I just feel like, man, some situations can really make or break careers. Being over here and being behind some guys, not being in the rotation, we all felt for him…”

Michael Porter Jr on Bol Bol, Jan 17, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Bol Bol
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on Bol Bol:

“I'm so proud of him. You can make a case that Bol Bol should be in the Most Improved Player conversation.”

Michael Malone on Bol Bol, Jan 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Bol Bol
item.description:
Kevin Durant on the @OrlandoMagic's @Bol Bol :

“He's unique. He's tough to deal with. [...] He can do pretty much everything on the basketball court.”

Kevin Durant on Bol Bol, Nov 30, 2022. Source: Twitter @Dan_Savage.

item.title: Paolo Banchero on Bol Bol
item.description:
Magic star Paolo Banchero told HoopsHype when asked who compares to Bol.

“I’m not trying to compare them, but Bol’s 7-foot-2, shoots threes, brings it up the court, makes passes, and blocks shots. I feel like people kind of forget about him, but Bol’s a freak of nature.”

Paolo Banchero on Bol Bol, Nov 29, 2022. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Monty Williams on Bol Bol, Wendell Carter, Franz Wagner
item.description:
Suns coachMonty Williams:

“Bol [Bol] is just…different. [Wendell] Carter is underrated. I liked him in Chicago. He’s better than advertised. [Franz] Wagner is one of the best young players in the league. He can flat-out go.”

Monty Williams on Bol Bol, Wendell Carter, Franz Wagner, Nov 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @khobi_price.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Bol Bol
item.description:
Jay King:Ime Udoka on Bol Bol:

“At best he’d be back late in the season, if at all.”

Ime Udoka on Bol Bol, Jan 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Michael Malone on Bol Bol
item.description:
Michael Singer:Michael Malone on Bol:

“When I think of how you define a player regarding his position, I always look at it from a defensive perspective. Who can you guard?”

Michael Malone on Bol Bol, Dec 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Monte Morris on Bol Bol
item.description:
Duvalier Johnson:Monte Morris on the best parts of Bol Bol:

“I'm not as surprised with the passing. I'm more surprised with him on defense and how he can help you and start the break.”

Monte Morris on Bol Bol, Aug 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @DuvalierJohnson.

item.title: Michael Malone on Bol Bol
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on Bol Bol:

“The scary thing is, he had 16, 10 and 6 the other night and I think he played OK.”

Michael Malone on Bol Bol, Jul 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Mason Plumlee on Bol Bol
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Mason Plumlee on Bol Bol:

“He's special. Super talent.....he's a welcomed addition. He's had a great attitude.”

Mason Plumlee on Bol Bol, Jul 12, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.
